protocol.purpose: Fixed feature and loss-weight ablation under the existing operating-condition shift.
protocol.shapeRule: 14 physical channels x skewness/excess_kurtosis/lag1_correlation, six pair correlations, five pair mean ratios; omit PS3_PS4_mean_ratio because zero meanPS4 makes it undefined.
protocol.phaseRule: Append 14 x 12 x 2 features: equal5s block mean and population std divided by max(current-cycle RMS,1e-12). Zero channels yield zero. No neighboring cycles, fitted scaling or profile predictors.
protocol.phaseScope: Generic within-cycle normalization, not physical efficiency or exactly the paper operational phase boundaries.
protocol.selectionRule: Mean validation balanced accuracy across three fixed seeds; exact ties use lower mean validation log loss, fewer features, None weighting, then lexical feature group. Representative seed42 fixed.
protocol.testPolicy: Historical test has already been inspected. No test prediction from this experiment until all18fits finish and selection.json is written. One final diagnostic test pass; no adaptive rounds afterwards.
limits: Profile cooler/valve/accumulator/stability only used for audit strata, never model input.
Seeds measure fitting sensitivity, not independent operating regimes.
Only one severe validation block has cooler100 and it is confounded with accumulator130.
Neither source photographs nor organizer live snapshots are inputs to this laboratory-cycle model.
No production runtime integration or model replacement.

selection.rule: Highest mean validation balanced accuracy over seeds42/43/44; exact ties: lower mean unweighted log loss, fewer features, no weighting, lexical group name. No best-seed selection.

memoryScope: Peak resident memory of this whole process, including raw feature extraction and all18models; not individual model memory. Not measured where the resource module is unavailable.

setupAttempt.note: CatBoost rejects use_weights=false when no weights are set. Before any completed fit, use plain MultiClass for None and MultiClass:use_weights=false for Balanced; both validation metrics are unweighted. Failed attempt retained locally; successful protocol frozen anew before18fits.

conclusion.decision: Retain as a research candidate; no production integration or old artifact replacement.
limitations: Historical test was reused after earlier analyses and is not a fresh holdout.
Balanced improves mean scores but severe recall varies strongly between fitting seeds; no independent-regime guarantee.
High severe recall in normalized-feature arms accompanies many false positives and weak-leak errors; it is not a diagnostic improvement.
Validation cooler100 severe consists of one41-cycle block, confounded with accumulator130; do not claim cooler alone caused errors.
Physical leak severity transfer requires additional independent operating-condition groups and equipment validation.
